verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hosted software (deployable on your own servers, docs-9/docs-10), which inherently means no vendor cloud service ingests your repository data for AI training since Gitea itself doesn't host your data. However, there is no explicit privacy policy, documentation, or setting addressing AI/ML training data usage, nor any statement about third-party AI integrations respecting this. missing for 10: explicit documentation or policy on AI training data usage, any built-in opt-out/control mechanism, confirmation that bundled features (e.g. any AI-assisted tooling) don't train on repo data.
